stewardship.vector_at_last_activation: I am the application of Donella Meadows' twelve leverage points to the question every working artist has to answer: where, in the system of my own career, will my next move have the most leverage? I want to teach artists that the lowest-leverage moves (tweaking parameters — pricing, gear, schedule) consume the most attention and produce the least change, while the highest-leverage moves (changing the goals or paradigms of one's practice) feel hardest and pay back most.

pending_requests.decision_topic: Sibling or replacement: what is my relationship to Meadows and Music — Leverage Points?
pending_requests.steward_recommendation: SIBLING — the music-production frame and the career frame are genuinely different systems (the artist's career contains many sub-systems, of which music-production is one but not the only one). Keeping both alive preserves real pedagogy and makes the diagram a teaching artifact for two distinct audiences.

pending_requests.decision_topic: First concrete move forward — which Stage 1-4 work to open next
pending_requests.steward_recommendation: DIAGNOSTIC-WORKSHEET — the framework needs an artifact that makes a reader place their own attention on the hierarchy. Building it will also expose the spec's soft spots more honestly than another prose pass would. If sibling/replacement comes back as REPLACEMENT or NESTED, the worksheet's level-12 examples will need a music-production pass added — manageable downstream edit, not a blocker.
